title: Client switches session on handoff, voice follows
description:
As a member, I want the app to open the target session on a handoff and keep my voice session with it, so that speaking continues with the new bot.

Feature: Client handoff
  Scenario: Handoff switches the open session
    Given voice listening is on in /
    When turn.handoff names /ops/deploy
    Then /ops/deploy is open
    And spoken lines go to its bot
    And a replayed handoff does not switch again

Voice is locked to one session; no per-utterance routing.
right_now_summary: The client opens the target session on handoff and keeps voice with its bot.
